name: courier-default
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game sprite atlas, exact 4 columns by 2 rows, wide 2:1 canvas, eight equal SQUARE cells with generous empty gutters. Reference is identity only: the small hooded Courier, ivory hood, charcoal clothes, mint square backpack, white gloves and shoes. Render TRUE ORTHOGRAPHIC STRAIGHT DOWN camera 90 degrees above head, NOT rear portrait, NOT isometric. Facing NORTH/top of image in every frame. View crown of hood, shoulders, upper surface of backpack below head, small feet peeking behind; body compact and foreshortened, no upright torso. Knife in right hand (image right). Beautiful clean stylized 3D game art, crisp readable silhouette, subtle seams, mint edging. Exactly eight isolated full sprites, one centered per cell, body center identical each frame, same scale. Row1 left-to-right: idle; left foot step; right foot step; passing walk pose. Row2: knife arm drawn right/back windup; knife extended forward/north slash; arm sweeping inward followthrough; idle holding small dark Seeker phone in left hand. Keep the complete knife inside its cell, max sprite extent 70 percent cell, zero neighboring fragments. Actual transparent alpha background, no floor, no cast shadows, no labels, no text, no grids, no glow, no magenta. Preserve reference character identity but overhead anatomy is essential.

name: warehouse-world
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: extra tall vertical scrolling mobile adventure map BACKGROUND, portrait 1:3 aspect ratio, approximately 1024x3072. This is the WAREHOUSE DISTRICT of Steal a Seeker. Beautiful high-budget sculpted miniature toy city, aerial/isometric view, playful explorable storybook world with depth, as polished and engaging as a premium casual game's saga map but NOT candy. Continuous environment covering EVERY pixel, no black background, no isolated floating island. Palette consistent with reference Courier: deep evergreen teal ground, desaturated mint rooftops, cream highlights, warm amber windows, restrained Solana violet details. A wide calm winding paved open space through the middle for code-rendered level nodes; decorate both sides with warehouse buildings, mint shipping crates, canals, small arch bridges, tiny security drones, trees and tiny courier mascots. Seeker phones as monumental cargo vault landmarks: copy the reference phone's graphite back, separate round top camera and black vertical lower camera pill, no invented phone model. A few physical mint token coin sculptures and Solana three-slash emblems on buildings, no text labels. Light enough to read rich detail, rich gentle mint bounce light, avoid black/crushed shadows. Small detailed landmarks throughout full vertical length, no gigantic foreground object. Top and bottom end in matching dark teal stone paving for clean repeat/transition. No UI, no numbers, no buttons, no typography, no border. References: 1 real Seeker phone identity; 2 Courier identity and palette.

MIDDLE RIGHT: Mert from reference3, bald with dark full beard, holding a compact stylized sci-fi guard gun, one tiny amber muzzle flash aimed at EMPTY pavement behind a fleeing tiny courier. Rich natural integration, no sticker borders, no text or UI, no numbers, keep walkway usable.
